career_overview.short_description: Make software delivery more repeatable and reliable. Learn basic Linux, version control, containers, automation and monitoring.
responsibilities: Assess goals and constraints relevant to devops engineer work
Apply appropriate tools and methods to a bounded task
representative_work: A small version-controlled application with automated checks and documented deployment.

roadmap.final_outcome: A small version-controlled application with automated checks and documented deployment.
